entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose redemption is spoken of; he is addressed as a young knight-in-training and speaks of defeating aggressors.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: Leader of Kytheon's Irregulars in Akros, who threw the spear that felled his friends and was taught by Warden Hixus.

entities.name: Warden Hixus
entities.description: A warden who instructs Kytheon on hieromancy and control.

entities.name: Kytheon's Irregulars
entities.description: A group that worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city on Theros attacked by harpies and home to the Temple of Triumph.

entities.name: Temple of Triumph
entities.description: A temple in Akros where a phalanx stood against a host of enemies.

entities.name: Brezard Skeinbow
entities.description: Captain of the guard who scoffs at the claim that a southern fortress was taken.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world whose gallant knights wear a sigil; Asha left it with protection and order.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: Someone who left Bant, ensuring the world would have protection and order in her absence.

entities.name: Mirinthes
entities.description: An Akroan captain who warns of canyons in the Phoberos badlands.

entities.name: Kanlos
entities.description: An Akroan captain who recalls the eagles circling.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist who makes skaabs and fights the cathars.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A mage who hit Jace with the full force of his mind and keeps notes, theories and ponderings in an archive; he speaks of balance and the mage-rings.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and telepath who hears people's thoughts and can speak into a mage's mind.

entities.name: Keyta
entities.description: A rebel hydromancer who calls the sea.

entities.name: Old Fishbones
entities.description: A Martyne river guide.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: A god who hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: Owner of a tower served by those who once sought to enter it uninvited.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who honed her powers on Innistrad and is troubled by angels.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where Liliana practiced necromancy on scores of undead.

entities.name: Pel Javya
entities.description: A Wojek investigator.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker and elf animist from Zendikar, the last of the animists, who wants to help Zendikar.

entities.name: Dwynen
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf daen who hunts eyeblights with her elves.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A speaker of a necromantic maxim.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A nightmare-weaving planeswalker.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who promises to be Liliana's demanding master.

entities.name: Alkmenos
entities.description: A proud man who would not bow to Erebos in death and is bowed for all eternity.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead on Theros.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker whose gift set others aflame; she faced execution and was pursued by fire monks.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A living city on Kaladesh with an aether grid and gearcrafters.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane whose artificers strive for perfection.

entities.name: Tarvik Relicsmasher
entities.description: A giant who dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe and took a new name.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: A Ghirapur inventor.

entities.name: Numa
entities.description: Joraga chieftain who speaks of standing together and of Nissa being the last of the animists.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: A tribe of elves on Zendikar.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: Perfect of Lys Alana who ordered trees rearranged, thus creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A wood born of trees rearranged by Eidren's order.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane in pain whose land punished the animists.

entities.name: Radwick
entities.description: A farmer of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Mulak Ffar
entities.description: Author of Vastwood Biodiversity.

entities.name: Arrester Lavinia
entities.description: An arrester of the Tenth Precinct.

entities.name: Sergeant Ryda
entities.description: A sergeant who warns of a seismic elemental.

entities.name: Terhold
entities.description: Archmage of Drunau.

entities.name: Maggath
entities.description: A Sardian elementalist.

entities.name: Dejara
entities.description: A Giltwood druid.

entities.name: Dionus
entities.description: An elvish archdruid.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer whom Chandra hopes to meet.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: Author of writings on faith.

entities.name: Foundry of the Consuls
entities.description: A foundry where automatons turned to face Chandra.

events.summary: Kytheon's own thrown spear fells his friends.
events.quote: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

events.summary: Kytheon and his irregulars work outside the law to bring justice to Akros.
events.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

events.summary: A phalanx stands together in the Temple of Triumph against a host of enemies.
events.quote: They became a single entity, a phalanx in the Temple of Triumph standing against a host of enemies.

events.summary: Harpies descend on Akros and are met by javelineers.
events.quote: The harpies descended without mercy upon Akros, only to find their attack put them within range of the javelineers.

events.summary: Alhammarret rises and strikes Jace with the full force of his mind.
events.quote: Alhammarret rose to his feet, and the full force of his mind hit Jace like a storm front.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring protection and order.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Liliana honed necromancy on Innistrad on undead and sometimes the living.
events.quote: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

events.summary: Liliana sees the attention of angels as testament to her power.
events.quote: Liliana viewed the attention of the angels as a testament to her power.

events.summary: In the moment before her execution Chandra realizes what it meant to be a pyromancer.
events.quote: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

events.summary: The fire monks cannot keep up with Chandra in time.
events.quote: In time, not even the fire monks could keep up with Chandra.

events.summary: Automatons in the foundry turn to face Chandra.
events.quote: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

events.summary: Tarvik takes the name Relicsmasher after a dream.
events.quote: When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

events.summary: Eidren has trees rearranged, giving birth to the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

events.summary: The evil inside the mountain pulses at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.
events.quote: The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.

events.summary: Nissa reacts instinctively with her blade.
events.quote: Nissa had only the space of a heartbeat to react, her instincts steering her blade.

events.summary: Nissa finds marsh vines can ensnare as well as forest vines.
events.quote: Nissa found that the vines of the marsh could ensnare just as well as forest vines could—maybe even better.

events.summary: Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain rather than vengeful.
events.quote: I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me.

events.summary: Nissa's people angered Zendikar and faced its wrath.
events.quote: Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath.

events.summary: Jace whispers in a mage's mind.
events.quote: "I know what you're thinking," Jace whispered in the mage's mind.

events.summary: Kruphix hides dire prophecies about humankind.
events.quote: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

events.summary: Alkmenos is bowed for eternity for refusing to bow to Erebos.
events.quote: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

relations.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.
Alhammarret rose to his feet, and the full force of his mind hit Jace like a storm front.

relations.note: Kothophed promises to be her demanding master.
relations.quote: I will be your most demanding master, Liliana.
I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way.
